system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Records the subsidy application against a completed purchase. For your information, my transaction_id is None.

function.name: ifms_apply_subsidy
function.description: Records the subsidy application against a completed purchase. Transitions subsidy_status to 'applied'. Subsidy is provided to fertilizer companies (not farmers directly) — the farmer benefit is the reduced price. Purchase must be 'completed'. Requires session_token. Does NOT settle subsidy with company. Fails if purchase not completed, subsidy already applied, or quantity-subsidy mismatch.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
